description: Na₅Nd₄Ge₄O₁₆F crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.61 Å. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.87 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.75 Å. Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.63 Å. The Nd-F bond length is 2.63 Å. Ge is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.79 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nd, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nd, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nd, and one Ge atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na, one Nd, and one Ge atom to form distorted ONa₃NdGe square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FNa₂Nd₄ octahedra and edges with three equivalent ONa₃NdGe square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 34°. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Nd atoms to form FNa₂Nd₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Nd₄ octahedra and corners with four equivalent ONa₃NdGe square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
